content.short: Ebisu is a stablecoin credit market where users borrow ebUSD against BTC, ETH and USD-pegged assets.
content.description: Ebisu is a stablecoin credit market built on a CDP model: users borrow its ebUSD stablecoin against BTC, ETH and USD-pegged collateral at market-set interest rates. ebUSD holders can in turn take part in those credit markets. It is deployed on Plasma. It is distinct from Ebisu's Bay, an unrelated NFT marketplace.
content.meta: Ebisu is a CDP stablecoin credit market for borrowing ebUSD against BTC, ETH and stablecoins, on Plasma.
